item.text: [{"task_id":"d9f24cd1","source_lines":["def run(params, grid, demos):","    background = int(round(params['colors'][0]))","    trail = int(round(params['colors'][1]))","    obstacle = int(round(params['colors'][2]))","    up = int(round(params['motion'][0]))","    right = int(round(params['motion'][1]))","    lower = int(round(params['motion'][2]))","    out = grid.copy()","    height, width = grid.shape","    start = height + up","    if start < lower or start >= height or up >= lower or right <= lower:","        return out","    seeds = np.argwhere(grid[start] == trail)","    for seed in seeds:","        col = int(seed[0])","        row = start","        while lower <= row < height and lower <= col < width:","            if grid[row, col] == background or grid[row, col] == trail:","                out[row, col] = trail","            ahead = row + up","            if ahead < lower or ahead >= height:","                break","            while lower <= col < width and grid[ahead, col] == obstacle:","                col = col + right","                if lower <= col < width:","                    if grid[row, col] == background or grid[row, col] == trail:","                        out[row, col] = trail","            row = ahead","    return out"],"shapes":{"colors":[3],"motion":[3]},"params":{"colors":[0,2,5],"motion":[-1,1,0]},"rationale":"Each bottom red seed grows upward. When a gray cell blocks its next step, the trail moves one column right on the row below the obstacle, then continues upward. Gray cells remain unchanged."}]
